macroplaza.name: Macroplaza
macroplaza.tip: One of the largest plazas in the world. Walk the full length from the Faro del Comercio to the Palacio Municipal.

bosque_magico.name: Bosque Mágico
bosque_magico.price_text: Check on the day · some rides cost extra
bosque_magico.hours: Check on the day · typically daytime into evening
bosque_magico.tip: Family park with rides and green space. Confirm opening hours before you go.

estadio_bbva.name: Estadio BBVA
estadio_bbva.price_text: Match tickets vary · stadium tours priced separately
estadio_bbva.hours: Match days and tour times vary · check on the day
estadio_bbva.tip: Home of Rayados. Book a stadium tour or catch a match; buy tickets in advance.
estadio_bbva.best: Match day or a scheduled tour

plaza_sesamo.name: Parque Plaza Sésamo
plaza_sesamo.price_text: Check on the day · entry and rides priced separately
plaza_sesamo.hours: Check on the day · typically daytime
plaza_sesamo.tip: Theme park aimed at young children. Check hours and ticket prices online first.

barrio_antiguo_walk.name: Barrio Antiguo walk
barrio_antiguo_walk.tip: Cobbled streets, old houses and bars. Walk it in the evening for the atmosphere.

mercado_juarez.name: Mercado Juárez
mercado_juarez.hours: Check on the day · typically daytime
mercado_juarez.tip: Try local snacks and fresh produce. Bring small cash.

parque_fundidora.name: Parque Fundidora
parque_fundidora.hours: Check on the day · typically open daily
parque_fundidora.tip: Big industrial-heritage park with paths and museums. Rent a bike to cover more ground.

paseo_santa_lucia.name: Paseo Santa Lucía
paseo_santa_lucia.price_text: Walk free · boat rides priced separately
paseo_santa_lucia.tip: Canal walk linking Macroplaza to Fundidora. Take the boat one way and walk back.

mirador_cerro_silla.name: Cerro de la Silla viewpoint
mirador_cerro_silla.tip: The saddle-shaped mountain is the city's icon. View it from a safe, open spot; check local advice on trails.

museo_historia_mexicano.name: Museo de Historia Mexicana
museo_historia_mexicano.price_text: Check on the day · discounts for students and seniors
museo_historia_mexicano.hours: Check on the day · usually closed one weekday
museo_historia_mexicano.tip: Good overview of Mexican history near the canal. Confirm hours before you go.
museo_historia_mexicano.best: Any time; avoid the closed day

carne_asada_dinner.name: Carne asada dinner
carne_asada_dinner.tip: Monterrey is famous for grilled beef. Book a popular parrilla ahead on weekends.

city_tour.name: City highlights tour
city_tour.hours: Departures vary · check on the day
city_tour.tip: A guided tour helps first-timers link Macroplaza, Barrio Antiguo and Fundidora. Confirm pickup and language.

calle_morelos.name: Calle Morelos stroll
calle_morelos.tip: Central street for shops and snacks. Good for a short walk between sights.

fundidora_museum.name: Museo del Acero Horno3
fundidora_museum.price_text: Check on the day · ticket prices vary
fundidora_museum.hours: Check on the day · usually closed one weekday
fundidora_museum.tip: Old steel furnace turned museum inside Fundidora. Confirm hours and lift access.

san_pedro_calzada.name: Calzada del Valle walk
san_pedro_calzada.tip: Leafy avenue in San Pedro for a relaxed walk and cafes. Good for a slower afternoon.

catedral.name: Catedral de Monterrey
catedral.hours: Check on the day · usually open daytime
catedral.tip: Historic cathedral on the Macroplaza edge. Dress respectfully and keep quiet during services.

palacio_gobierno.name: Palacio de Gobierno
palacio_gobierno.price_text: Free · check if entry is open
palacio_gobierno.hours: Check on the day · weekday hours likely
palacio_gobierno.tip: Historic government building facing the plaza. Ask at the door about visiting the interior.

faro_comercio.name: Faro del Comercio
faro_comercio.tip: Lighthouse-shaped monument on the Macroplaza. Best photo spot is from the plaza at dusk.

parque_ecologico_chipinque.name: Parque Ecológico Chipinque
parque_ecologico_chipinque.price_text: Check on the day · entry fee per vehicle or person
parque_ecologico_chipinque.hours: Check on the day · usually daytime, closed some days
parque_ecologico_chipinque.tip: Mountain park above the city with trails and views. Go early and check access rules.

grutas_garcia.name: Grutas de García day trip
grutas_garcia.price_text: ≈ MXN 300–600 including transport · check on the day
grutas_garcia.hours: Check on the day · tours run daytime
grutas_garcia.tip: Cave tour outside the city. Bring a light jacket and confirm the cable car is running.

noche_barrio.name: Barrio Antiguo night out
noche_barrio.price_text: Pay per drink · varies by venue
noche_barrio.hours: Evenings into late night, mainly Thu–Sat
noche_barrio.tip: Bars and music in the old quarter. Keep valuables close and agree on a taxi back.
